column1: # The rows tools/ops/call_profile_job.sh profiles by default (CP_ROWS_FILE names another file of this form).
# One row per line, whitespace separated: race id, forced phase, then optional `name=<row>` (default: the lane, with
# `-<phase>` when the same race is listed twice). Phase: `fit`, or `infer` for an algos race (its inference phase is
# named `infer`), `infer/<batch>` for a tree race. Small calls that carry a fixed extra cost on wheel d652a4b0a1
# internal call-overhead row as the control with a known thin path (one host call per step, no GPU work).
